lines.en: My orange scales catch the light.
I walk lighter than my kind.
The blades on my shoulders open and close.
I cross the cracked badland soil.
My shadow carries an orange tint.
I lope across the ground.
I pause on the slope.
My tail sweeps the gravel aside.
Three steps, then a stop.

lines.zh: 断柱挡路，我从旁边掠过
lines.en: A broken pillar blocks the way, I slip past
My heat markings glow brighter.
I head for my anchor.
Lowering my head is a bit clumsy.
One step crushes a clod of earth.
I keep to these badlands.
Orange stands out more than I expected.
I am honing my shoulder blades.
The anchor has not moved, neither do I.
I am smelling the stones.
My form is rather uncommon.
Waiting for something edible.

lines.zh: 我看到自己的影子在动
lines.en: I see my own shadow shift.

lines.zh: 风从矿山那边刮来，有铁
lines.en: The wind from the mine smells of iron
I want to see the jungle side.
My claws will not retract fully.
A while longer.
I lift my head to the distance.
My markings are slowly dimming.

lines.zh: 我们对着看，先眨眼的是你
lines.en: We stare, and you blink first
My color is unusual, is it not?
I am not the common sort.
Do not take me for the other one.
Are you going to feed me?
The seat on my back is empty.
I smell your hands.
Your boots are a nice color.
Are you not wary of orange?
I have not decided yet.

lines.zh: 站我正前方的，都先挨撞
lines.en: Whatever stands in front of me gets hit first
When I grin, my teeth show.
Hold it up higher.
That smell from last time, it was you

lines.zh: 隔着皮，我听得见你的心跳
lines.en: Through your skin I hear your heartbeat
I am considering where to bite.
You hit my orange plate.
My plates clang once and I hold my ground

lines.zh: 这力度，把我的纹压暗了
lines.en: That blow dimmed my markings
I force a growl from deep in my throat.
Blood runs from the shoulder seam.
My markings dimmed a little.
My knees have not buckled, I can still lunge
You hit well.

lines.zh: 你的血味，进了我的数据
lines.en: Your blood is in my data now
Do not think I will back off.
That meat looks tender.

lines.zh: 铁锈似的甜，是新鲜的血
lines.en: That rusty sweetness is fresh blood
The thing in your hand.

lines.zh: 我压低脖子，凑向那块肉
lines.en: I lower my neck toward the meat
Do not put it away.
My belly is rumbling.
That is just right for one bite.
One twitch and I bite fingers
I like orange things.
Half a step more and it is at my jaws
I am about to bite.
Just put it down.
My shoulder plate knocks you, loud
I nearly lost my footing.
Orange does not mean gentle.
You are shoved half a meter.
My plates clattered.
Bump me and you run?
I turn to stare at you.
Do not step on my tail tip.
The soil here is too loose.

lines.zh: 撞一次算招呼，两次算挑衅
lines.en: One bump is a greeting, two is a challenge

lines.zh: 我的形态和其他人不一样
lines.en: My form differs from the others.

lines.zh: 这跟我是不是橙色无关
lines.en: My being orange has nothing to do with it.
I have no such setting.
Do not press against my blades.
My anchor would notice.
I am not good at this.
The blades will catch you, back off

lines.zh: 橙色也挡不住这些麻烦
lines.en: Being orange does not help with this.
Forget it.
I am going back to my patrol.
I pin it down.
Not even half a mouthful
Holding it, my neck sags
I crush it in one bite.
I carry it back to my anchor.
I pick up what falls on the badlands too.
I prefer the orange ones.
This tastes all right.
Do not take it.
I will taste it first.
You have provoked me.
Orange does not mean good temper.

lines.zh: 橙色伏低，是起跑的前奏
lines.en: Orange crouched low is the prelude to a charge
You are at the ravine edge.
My markings lit up.
This bite will be hot.
You have only this path.
My blades are up.
Did you hear that growl?
Do not confuse me with the other.
I have decided.
You had better run now.
I stay at your left.
No cover in the badlands.

lines.zh: 我的橙色很远就看得见
lines.en: My orange shows from far off.
But you cannot hide.
One of my strides is three of yours
I follow along the broken pillars.

lines.zh: 你踩裂的土，一路指着我
lines.en: The earth you cracked points me along
Your breaths are short, you cannot run long
I moved downwind of you.
Your scent is ahead.
I will run a little faster.
You have your last few steps.
I bite your shoulder.
My shoulder blade sweeps your leg.
You are knocked into the dirt.

lines.zh: 刃上还挂着热气，擦过你
lines.en: My blade still trailing heat as it grazes you
I hook you with a claw.
Your grip came loose.
My tail hits your knee.
You are at the rock face.
Another bite.
That crack was not stone
The orange is hot too.

lines.zh: 你的脚跟已经开始打滑
lines.en: Your heels are starting to slip
I appear on the badlands.

lines.zh: 橙色在一片红土里很显眼
lines.en: Orange stands out in red earth.
I crushed stone on landing.
My anchor is here.
A few of us came out below the slope.
I shake the dirt off my armor.
I lift my head to the wind.
This place is good for patrolling.
I need to eat something.

lines.zh: 热纹从肩头一路烧到腰
lines.en: Heat marks burn from shoulder to hip
I raise a forepaw slowly.
I have not found prey yet.
Here I am, orange, among the stones.
I do not know this area.
Fire makes my orange burn brighter.
I rolled off the ravine edge.
The water put out my markings.
The earth rained down on me.
An arrow stuck between my scales.
My data was scrambled.

lines.zh: 红土里连虫子都藏得深
lines.en: Even the grubs hide deep in this red dirt
Lightning crawled down my shoulder blade.
My color is fading.
